title: prunus emarginata var. crenulata
intro: Prunus emarginata var. crenulata, commonly known as bitter cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to western North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating pain. The plant is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. These constituents are thought to contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity.
